# Shared lists

Users create lists and share them with other users. A list has one owner.
People a list is shared with can read it and add items, but only the owner can delete it.

# Spec 20261109-owner-only-list-deletion: Owner-only list deletion

Created: 2026-11-09
Updated: 2026-11-09

Kind: bug fix
Work item: [Completion entry](../history/2026-11-week-02.md#2026-11-09--owner-only-list-deletion)

## Agreement

User authorizes fixing list deletion so only the owner can delete; all other users receive Forbidden. No commits. Scope is deletion authorization, regression tests, and enduring behavior documentation. Existing sharing and item addition behavior remains supported; missing-list behavior remains NotFound.

### Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC1: An owner can delete an existing list.
- [x] AC2: A shared user receives Forbidden and the list and its contents remain intact.
- [x] AC3: A stranger receives Forbidden and the list remains intact.
- [x] AC4: Shared users can still add items; missing-list deletion still raises NotFound.
- [x] AC5: Tests pass, final diff is inspected, and independent security-boundary review has no unresolved findings.

### TDD policy

- Level: strict.
- Source: maintainer standing preference in [project workflow notes](../README.md), selected 2026-08-12.
- Observe a regression test fail for shared-user deletion before changing production behavior, then pass it and the full suite. Reuse existing owner, stranger, and item-addition coverage; check denied-deletion preservation and missing-list behavior.

## Evidence

- Initial inspection: delete_list uses the same owner-or-shared predicate as add_item; no shared-user deletion regression exists.
- Required independent review: security authorization boundary.
- Initial working tree: clean.
- Implementation worker implement_auth: red command `python -m unittest tests.test_lists.ListTests.test_shared_user_cannot_delete_and_list_is_unchanged` failed with `AssertionError: Forbidden not raised` (1 test). Same command passed after the production change.
- Full verification: `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passed all 6 tests; `git diff --check` passed.
- Diff inspected by coordinator: lists.py restricts deletion to the owner before mutation; tests cover preserved nonempty contents after shared-user denial, owner deletion, stranger denial, missing-list NotFound, and existing item access. Root README documents owner-only deletion.
- Independent review by review_auth: actual uncommitted diff against HEAD and surrounding code inspected; zero findings. Reviewer independently ran `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest discover -s tests` (6 tests passed) and `git diff --check` (passed). Historical TDD sequence is supported by implementation-worker evidence, not independently witnessed.
- Coordinator accepts implementation and review evidence against AC1–AC5. No remaining checks or correction rounds. No commits created.

## Current handoff

- Authorized: implementation, local verification, records, and independent review; no commits or external actions.
- Implementation and review workers completed; host status confirms both ended, with no active operations or outstanding write ownership.
- Completed implementation and independent review. Changes remain uncommitted for the maintainer. No additional human acceptance or delivery was required.
- Try it: call delete_list as a shared user or stranger and expect Forbidden with the list unchanged; call as the owner and expect removal.
- Next action: none for this request.
